why: Learner-Generated Context is a technology-oriented, autonomy-focused formulation of constructivism because it treats learners as actively constructing knowledge through interaction with resources rather than receiving it passively.
The LGBT-DOCSS is a named clinical assessment instrument rather than a general instructional element.
name: LGBT-DOCSS scale (Polish and Spanish versions)
product_description: A validated 18-item self-administered Likert-scale instrument for assessing health professionals' clinical preparedness, attitudes, and knowledge when working with LGBT patients.
